ledger.claim: The transactional artifacts all describe this one trip: EV-TRIP-00102, EV-GPS-00102 and EV-FARE-00102 each carry trip_id TRP-00102, and the trace's first fix at 2026-07-19T11:23:30+08:00 matches the trip record's started_at. The rider therefore discharges the identification limb of POL-RD-08(a) and the debate proceeds on this trip's own evidence.

On the field POL-RD-01 makes governing — gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 21.79 km — the excess over the 20.4 km optimal route is 1.39 km, which clears the 0.8 km absolute establishment limb. The 21.8 km figure on the trip record is a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and is not cited for the threshold test.

The driver's explanation — that the BKE was crawling near Dairy Farm so he came off via Upper Thomson — is unsupported by any record. EV-ADVIS-00102-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and no advisory covers the BKE or the Upper Bukit Timah corridor for the 11:16-11:55 window. With no advisory on file, POL-RD-03 cannot be run, and under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 the driver's uncited traffic assertion carries no weight: it can neither excuse the excess nor supply an amended optimal route.

The only chat message is the driver's own — 'boss BKE quite jam, i go Upper Bukit Timah ok?', sent by the DRIVER at 11:29:04, read at 11:29:40 and never answered by the rider — and it carries no waypoint_hint. POL-RD-04 exonerates a detour only where the instruction comes from the rider and identifies a place or road specific enough to act on, so the rider-requested-detour route to exoneration is simply unavailable to the driver on this record.

The rider must candidly accept the one fact that decides this case. The excess on the governing trace is 6.81% of the optimal distance, below the 20% limb of POL-RD-01, and POL-RD-01 requires BOTH the percentage limb and the 0.8 km limb to pass. The distance deviation is therefore not established on the trace, and the POL-RD-02 distance-and-time refund is not triggered. The rider does not press a refund the threshold does not support; the concession is made because the record, not the rider's preference about the route, governs.

The governing measurement under POL-RD-01 is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, not the rounded convenience copy on the trip record: the trace is 21.79 km against a booked optimal of 20.4 km, an excess of 1.39 km, or 6.81% of optimal. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be BOTH greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km; the 6.81% figure falls far short of the 20% limb, so the establishment test fails and no deviation exists on this trip.

The platform's own computation reads the same way: the derived deviation status on the trace is 'no deviation', and the trip record's deviation_pct is 6.9%. Neither the trace figure nor the trip record's figure comes anywhere near the 20% gate, so the threshold cannot be crossed on any reading of this record.

POL-RD-01's closing sentence governs the outcome: where either establishment test fails, no deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. The rider's sense that he would have driven another way cannot supply a deviation the measurements do not show, and the present payment state should stand.

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold before the burden shifts to the driver. The trace is unimpaired and shows an excess of 6.81%, below that threshold, so the burden never shifts and the driver is not required to point to any exculpatory clause at all.

POL-RD-01 is a distance test — excess kilometres measured against the optimal route — and not a duration test. The rider's complaint that the trip took 32 minutes against a normal 27 engages no threshold in the policy, and the trip record's own distances (21.8 km driven against a 20.4 km optimal) confirm the distance excess stays below the gate.

POL-RD-02's refund arithmetic runs only where a deviation is established under POL-RD-01. No deviation is established here, so the recomputed-fare and refund figures precomputed on the fare breakdown are not engaged, no refund of the $2.45 figure may issue, and the rider's payment stands as charged.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 193 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds. POL-RD-07's impairment consequences, and the independent-corroboration requirement that follows from them, therefore do not arise, and the case is decided on the measured trace rather than referred to a human reviewer.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you agree on the central measurement, and on that measurement no money moves.

THE DISTANCE TEST (POL-RD-01). The route was measured on the GPS trace EV-GPS-00102, which governs over the rounded copy on the trip record. The trace length is 21.79 km against a booked optimal of 20.4 km (EV-TRIP-00102) — an excess of 1.39 km, or 6.81% of optimal. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH more than 20% of optimal AND more than 0.8 km. The 0.8 km limb passes at 1.39 km, but the percentage limb fails at 6.81%, and both must pass. No deviation is therefore established, and POL-RD-01's closing sentence applies: the outcome is NO_ACTION however the trip is characterised. The rider's advocate conceded this candidly and correctly, and the driver's advocate's reading of the same figures is accepted.

THE FARE (POL-RD-02). Because no deviation is established, POL-RD-02's recomputation is not engaged. The $27.46 recomputed fare and the $2.45 refund precomputed on EV-FARE-00102 do not issue; the fare is METERED and the charged total of $29.91 stands. There is no billing-integrity defect under POL-RD-09(4): the ERP lines are empty and no airport surcharge was applied on this Woodlands-to-ION trip, so no pass-through correction arises.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXPLANATION (POL-RD-13, POL-RD-03, POL-RD-08). The driver's account — that the BKE was crawling near Dairy Farm so he diverted via Upper Thomson — was tested against the traffic advisory for this trip. EV-ADVIS-00102-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and no advisory covers the BKE or the Upper Bukit Timah corridor for the 11:16–11:55 window. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run, and under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 the traffic assertion carries no weight. The driver named no advisory evidence ID, so this is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. In any event it changes nothing: even disregarding the assertion entirely, the deviation is not established on the numbers.

TRACE INTEGRITY AND ESCALATION. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — 193 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0 seconds — so no independent-corroboration requirement and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arise. No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires. The driver's profile shows no material deviation and zero deviation flags in the last 90 days (0/640), so no POL-RD-06 conduct referral is produced.

The present state stands: the charge is left in place and no refund issues. The monetary effect is nil, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this ruling executes automatically on issue. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
